introParagraph:
Here, I occasionally publish posts that I personally find interesting or inspiring and would like to share with others.
The topics of these posts are not limited to a single area; you will find everything from software technology, programming, and modern tools to electronics, personal projects, various languages, and anything I find worthwhile to learn.

This space serves as a collection of experiences, ideas, and things I encounter on my learning and work journey – a diverse collection of knowledge that may also be useful or inspiring for you.
heroIntro: I'm a full stack developer based in Vienna, building modern, user-focused web applications with Next.js, React, Java, C#, and SQL. Here you'll find a bit about me and a blog where I share what I learn and find inspiring.
aboutCardText: Get to know my background, skills, and experience — from payment gateways and web platforms to core banking systems and scalable frontends.
blogCardText: Occasional posts on software, programming, electronics, and anything else I find worth learning and sharing.
